meta.coords: All rects are [x,y,w,h] in pixels of the referenced PNG (paths relative to this catalog). anchor = feet/ground point in px relative to the rect origin. footprintTiles = blocking footprint in 32px tiles, centered horizontally on the anchor, extending upward from it.
meta.characterBases: All humanoids use the same Universal-LPC adult base family (male / female / teen bodies, human heads, generator palettes). Pip (kid) uses the teen body + small male head instead of the chibi child body so proportions and outlines match.
meta.characterLayout: Composited LPC rows: walk rows 0-3 (up,left,down,right; 9 frames, frame 0 = standing), slash rows 4-7 (up,left,down,right; 6 frames). idle = walk frame 0.

edges.layout: LPC 3x3 overlay blob + 2x2 inner corners. Grass with transparent surroundings; draw over any base tile.

overDirt.note: grass ring pre-composited over dirt (dirt patch inside grass)

edges.layout: 3x3 pond block (center = open water) + 2x2 inner corners (land island in water). The *Overlay3x3 blocks are the same banks with a transparent centre, to draw over a water base tile.

water_anim.note: Animated water. frames.surface: 4 frames, each a seamless 192 px (6-tile) pattern of open water with Eliza Wyatt's water reflections, drawn 2x2 so any tile-sized window inside the pattern fits; laid in world space. banks: terrain.water edges with the flat open water cut out, so the surface shows through. lap: the client traces a lap line (color) just off the bank pixels of these sheets; water lists the sheets' water colours, which are not bank. styles: ms per frame and flow (drift in source px/s) per MapData.waterStyle.

wood.note: plank floor; each 32px column of the sheet is a different stain, so variants stay in the x=64 column

tilled_wet.note: derived: dry tilled soil + the sheet's semi-transparent wet overlay

edges.layout: Cliff autotile: rows 0-255 are cliff top/edge pieces over dirt (y 0-159) and grass (y 160-255); rows 288-415 are cliff faces.

wall.note: each palette block is 3x3: top row cap, middle fill, bottom row base

shadows.note: Flat two-step LPC-style drop shadows (LPC shadow colour #322125 at ~30-47% alpha). Draw centred on an entity's anchor (ground/feet point), before the entity. Flying entities keep the shadow on the ground at the anchor while the sprite floats above.

walls.note: Room shell, seen from inside. North wall = a row of 1x3 props iwall_<style>_<feature> (32x96: 16px wall-top cap, wall face, skirting) whose bottom row sits on the room's first floor row; stairs_up replaces two of them. Side/south walls are only their tops seen from above: draw the border3x3 pieces (transparent centre, overlay on the floor tiles). corner_nw/wall_n_top/corner_ne go on the row above the north wall pieces, wall_w/wall_e down the side columns, corner_sw/wall_s_cap/corner_se along the bottom row (leave a gap in wall_s_cap for the exit door). Inner thickness is ~16px of each 32px piece.

lights.note: Soft radial light glows (own-made, CC0), banded in 6 alpha steps. Draw centred on the light source with additive or screen blend over a night/interior darkness overlay; scale freely. radiusPx is the native radius in source px.
